rules: All artist-scored 4/5 and 5/5 old acquired works remain untouched; no re-acquisition or re-rating.
Numerical 0-2 artwork exclusions remain global; new original paintings by same artist are not automatically rejected.
'Attributed to', 'studio of', 'after' and 'copy' do not count as original Van Dyck/Caravaggio oeuvre.
One source page may cover two physically distinct canvases; URL-only dedup is invalid; inventory and artwork title identify them.
Museum image open view, press-use TIFF and scholarly publication metadata are not worldwide commercial reuse licences.
Original images are not acquired in this research batch; pixel-size, SHA-256, user 0-5 rating, crop rights remain pending.
The 2023 Louvre catalogue is of holdings, not 2004 Barnes world catalogue. Caravaggio Schütze catalogue page is only a numerical index, not evidence that its 89 numbers are 89 verified paintings.
